name: Muthathi River
description: Cauvery riverbanks, upstream rainfall and higher-ground access.

properties.name: Muthathi bank strong-current zone
properties.reason: Simulated - elevated turbulence modeled near confluence bend
properties.trigger_condition: activates when combined upstream reservoir release exceeds 10,000 cusecs (mock threshold)
properties.advisory: Simulated advisory: no wading or boating within this zone during active window.

properties.name: Sangama confluence eddy zone
properties.reason: Simulated - eddies typical near tributary confluence, modeled illustratively
properties.trigger_condition: activates during and 6 hours after any recorded rainfall event in Arkavathy catchment (mock threshold)
properties.advisory: Simulated advisory: exercise caution, currents may reverse unpredictably.

properties.name: Rocky rapids stretch near temple bend
properties.reason: Simulated - shallow rocky bed illustratively marked near temple placemark cluster
properties.trigger_condition: static hazard - always active regardless of flow (mock)
properties.advisory: Simulated advisory: no swimming, boating only with local guide.

properties.name: Downstream release surge buffer
properties.reason: Simulated buffer zone illustrating impact of sudden upstream dam gate opening
properties.trigger_condition: activates within 2-36 hours (mock travel-time window) after KRS/Kabini outflow exceeds 15,000 cusecs combined
properties.advisory: Simulated advisory: this zone would auto-activate on qualifying release event; currently dormant.

properties.name: Muthathi Main Restricted River Stretch (Temple/Tourist Access Area)
properties.description: Primary no-swimming / high-risk river stretch near the main Muthathi temple and tourist access point, built from the actual river channel width (both banks) traced in the uploaded KML. Verified as a documented high-incident zone: forest department prohibits swimming here due to whirlpools, sudden drop-offs, and strong current.
properties.documented_incidents: 120+ drowning deaths recorded since 2010 in the Muthathi stretch (Deccan Herald, TripAdvisor visitor reports)
properties.topology_repair: PostGIS ST_MakeValid; self-intersections split, no new survey evidence

properties.name: Muthathi Core Whirlpool / Deep-Water Zone
properties.description: Tighter high-severity sub-zone within the main restricted stretch, representing the core area where whirlpools and unexpected depth changes are most frequently reported by visitors and local authorities.
properties.topology_repair: PostGIS ST_MakeValid; self-intersections split, no new survey evidence

properties.name: Muthathi Hillock Temple Safe Zone (West)
properties.description: Elevated hillock temple along the forest approach road, matching visitor reports of a 'small hill with a village temple' well above the river valley. Highest verified elevation point in the uploaded KML.
properties.location: Muthathi, Kaveri River (Malavalli Taluk, Mandya District)

properties.name: Muthathi Hillock Temple Safe Zone (East)
properties.description: Second elevated hillock temple further along the approach road, also well above the river valley floor. Serves as an alternate/secondary high-ground evacuation point.
properties.location: Muthathi, Kaveri River (Malavalli Taluk, Mandya District)
